A [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Dark Jedi Conflict]], an event which took place in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] in [[181 BBY/Legends|181 BBY]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last millennia of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A student of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] was selected by a a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Dark Jedi Conflict)|female Jedi Consular]] to train as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Along with his master, the pair was dispatched by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to bring an end to the [[Dark Jedi Conflict]] which had consumed the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] in [[181 BBY/Legends|181 BBY]]. Teaching the natives of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] to fight and mobilize against the [[Kibh Jeen's army|armies]] of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]] [[Kibh Jeen]], the Jedi pair were able to lure Jeen's warriors into a trap. During [[Final battle of the Dark Jedi Conflict|the battle]], the Padawan and the Knight confronted Jeen and slew him, bringing his reign of terror to an end.<ref name="JVS" />
